snippet.title: Hoverise Rebellion - Official Gameplay Trailer | Demo on Steam #indiegame #indiedev #gamedev
snippet.description:
Hoverise Rebellion is a fast-paced vehicular arena shooter where you pilot agile HoverTanks, master powerful abilities, and fight across multiple arena game modes.

This trailer gives a new look at the world of Hoverise Rebellion, including HoverTank combat, powerful abilities, arena game modes, customization, and the upcoming campaign mode, where humanity fights back against the AI-controlled HoverTank rebellion to reclaim the planet.

The demo is available now on Steam!

Play the demo and wishlist Hoverise Rebellion:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902060
